provenance: New implementation from public inputs and Stage1-8 source. Not an exact recovery of Stage9/10.
candidate_policy: Exclude candidate captions that exactly equal one supplied reference in both human datasets, as implemented in the data producer before any scoring. Report observed row/candidate/image counts; do not equate changed pixel-hash identity or rebuilt Sugar split with historical Stage10 cohorts.

data.split_policy: Pixel-hash-disjoint train/validation/test globally. Polaris official TEST reserved first, Flickr prior100 reconstructed from public names; Sugar split rebuilt, not historical3949/560. Training excluded from all test media.

learning.selection: Mean validation gains across seeds must be nonnegative in all 3 domains. Maximize weakest gain normalized by [0.01,0.02,0.02]; fallback base. Select epoch on validation per seed; refit train+validation using median epoch. Seed11 single is primary; ensemble3 diagnostic.
learning.uncertainty: Human pair loss weighted by abs(meanA-meanB)/(abs(meanA-meanB)+SE(A)+SE(B)+1e-6), divided by sum of batch weights to retain equal domain budgets. Singleton SE=0 is a heuristic, not a calibrated uncertainty estimate. Comparison against mean phase is exploratory.
learning.ablation: Gemma only: fixed rank32 radius0.03 preservation0.1, full15epochs seed11; sugar_only, human_only, no_preservation, full_control. No test-based selection.

precision: Gemma FP32 on T4, BF16 only on hardware with native BF16 support; follow official model-card dynamic-range guidance and never use Gemma FP16. CLIP and SigLIP native FP16. Cache and adapters FP32. No equivalence claim across precisions. This correction was made before any Stage11 inference; data-producer v1 protocol may retain the preliminary FP16 plan, which does not affect its data-only computation.

latency.panel: 8 deterministic Flickr test records, predecoded images; includes preprocessing, encoding, normalization, scoring; excludes disk IO and model download. Interleave base/primary variants.

statistics.correlation: Kendall tau-c, raw individual votes and candidate mean separately

interpretation: Exploratory continuation on previously observed corpora. Changed Sugar split and new adapter prohibit direct attribution against historical Stage9/10. No SOTA or fresh holdout claim.
